intro.title: Screen tour
intro.body: We're still detailing the step-by-step for this screen. Use the Copilot (ask in natural language) to get usage help in the meantime.

intro.title: Ticket Center
intro.body: All tickets live here. Filter, search, and click a ticket to open the detail.

new.title: New ticket
new.body: Open a ticket here. As you type, Orbit suggests priority, points out duplicates, and offers existing solutions.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Refine by status, priority, team, assignee, and period. Search finds by title.

list.title: List
list.body: Each row is a ticket with priority, status, SLA, and assignee. Click to open.

intro.title: Ticket Detail
intro.body: Everything about the ticket in one place: description, assistant, comments, time, attachments, and history.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: Navigate between Overview, Conversation, Worklogs, Investigation, Items, and Attachments.

assistant.title: Resolution Assistant
assistant.body: Local engine recommendations: similar solutions, next step, and context signals.

resolve.title: Resolve
resolve.body: When closing, record root cause, steps, and outcome — this feeds the Solution Base.

intro.title: Operation Center
intro.body: Daily summary: open, at risk of SLA, distribution by status, and load by team.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.body: Track key numbers and adjust the period as needed.

intro.title: Analytics
intro.body: Analysis and trends by period and team to see patterns over time.

trends.title: Trends
trends.body: Compare volume, resolution time, and recurrence between periods.

intro.title: Intelligence
intro.body: Playbook coverage, reliability, and patterns mined from history.

aihealth.title: AI Health
aihealth.body: View trained models (accuracy, samples) and use Train now to update them.

intro.title: Solution Base
intro.body: Resolution playbooks mined from history. The team reviews and publishes.

review.title: Review
review.body: Drafts awaiting curation — approve the good ones, discard the noise.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Once published, the playbook is offered with full confidence on tickets.

intro.title: Recurrence Radar
intro.body: Groups recurring tickets into a Problem with accumulated impact.

anomalies.title: Volume anomalies
anomalies.body: Atypical spikes detected by AI (SR-CNN) — may indicate a large-scale incident.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.body: Take the Problem to engineering with the business case (incidents + hours).

intro.title: Reliability
intro.body: Calibration of offered confidence versus measured effectiveness through feedback.

intro.title: Performance
intro.body: Track points, level and the team ranking by productivity — light and professional.

me.title: My performance
me.body: Your level, points and where they come from: quality weighs more than volume.

history.title: Your evolution
history.body: How your points evolved over the past weeks.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.body: Badges for professional milestones — SLA streaks, knowledge created, criticals solved.

goals.title: Goals
goals.body: Goals set by managers and your progress toward the reward.

manageGoals.title: Manage goals
manageGoals.body: Managers only: create goals, define rewards and grant the ones achieved.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.body: Where the team stands — switch between individual and team.

season.title: Season
season.body: The ranking resets each month; champions stay in the Hall of Fame.

intro.title: Knowledge Copilot
intro.body: Ask in natural language: it searches history and Orbit's own guides.

input.title: Ask here
input.body: Describe the problem or paste a ticket title. It only states what it finds.

sources.title: Sources
sources.body: Answers include sources: playbooks, resolved tickets (navigable), and system guides.

intro.title: SLA Policies
intro.body: Define deadlines by priority and the company's business hours.

targets.title: Targets by priority
targets.body: Enter, in hours, the first response and resolution for each priority.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.body: When active, SLA counts only within business hours.

intro.title: Users
intro.body: Manage company people and their profile and team assignments.

intro.title: Profiles & Permissions
intro.body: Define roles and what each can do (PBAC).

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Check permissions by module; then link users to the profile.

intro.title: Audit
intro.body: Automatic record of all changes (who, what, when), with diff by field.

intro.title: Iterations
intro.body: Organize work by cycles (sprints); tickets are linked to the active iteration.

intro.title: Tags
intro.body: Labels to classify and filter tickets.

intro.title: Settings
intro.body: Company preferences: branding, language, timezone, and theme.

intro.title: Investigation
intro.body: Structure the analysis with evidence and hypotheses down to the root cause (5 Whys).

notifications.body: Track real-time updates of your tickets and assignments.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Toggle between light and dark modes as you prefer.

user.title: Your account
user.body: Manage your profile, enable two-step verification (MFA), and sign out securely.

done.title: All set!
